name: @intellectual-frontiers/anyfs-posix
description: The POSIX view of any AnyFS store: directories derived from prefixes, handles with write-back, and every operation labelled native, emulated or refused, so a command line, a WebDAV or NFS server or a mount can treat any store as a file system without pretending.

scripts.verify: tsc -p tsconfig.json && bun ../../tools/mizan-check.ts --root spec-kit && bun ../../libraries/src/check.ts --root spec-kit --level L1 && bun ../../kanon/src/check.ts && bun tools/check.ts && bun test suite/ && bun tools/pack.ts --check
